references.title: DWDS: Gefahr
references.supports: No Wortzerlegung; Etymologie: mhd. gevāre 'ist eine verstärkende Präfixbildung zu ahd. fāra' (nhd. Fahr, in use until the 18th century)

references.title: en.wiktionary: Gefahr
references.supports: German etymology: inherited from MHG gevāre, from OHG fāra; no German formation given

notes.rationale: The ge- of mhd. gevāre is a fossilized prefix: DWDS gives no Wortzerlegung to confirm the split, and its base Fahr has died out, so it stays inside the Root, as in Geselle (ADR 0051). A bottom word: the Root gefahr and the zero ending.
